questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Desperate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Desperate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Content'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Desperate' is 'Content'.
  • Desperate: out of control and ready to do anything to change the situation you are in because it is so terrible. (अत्‍यधिक निराशा के कारण दुस्‍साहसी, निराशोन्‍मत)
    • Example: She became desperate when her money ran out.
  • Content: happy or satisfied with what you have or do. (संतुष्‍ट)
    • Example: I don’t need a new car—I’m perfectly content with the one I’ve got.
       

Correct Answer: Content.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Determined: having firmly decided to do something or to succeed, even if it is difficult. (कठिन होने के बावजूद किसी काम में सफलता प्राप्त करने का संकल्प, कृतसंकल्‍प, दृढ़निश्‍चयी)
    • Frantic: extremely worried or frightened. (अत्‍यधिक चिंतित या भयभीत)
    • Daring: involving or taking risks; brave. (साहसी; बहादुर, निर्भीक)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Discreet
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Discreet
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'tactless'.

Key Points

  •  The given word 'discreet ' means tactful, prudent, or careful to avoid revealing things that may cause embarrassment.
    • Example: The family made discreet inquiries about his background.
  • Tactless means not being careful about saying or doing something that could upset someone.
  • From the above meaning of the marked option, it is clear that 'discreet' and tactless are antonyms of each other.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Tropical
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Tropical
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Cold'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Tropical' is 'Cold'.
  • Tropical: very hot and humid. (बहुत गर्म और आर्द्र)
    • Example: tropical fruit...
  • Cold: of or at a low or relatively low temperature, especially when compared with the human body. (न्‍यून तापमान वाला; ठंडा, शीत)
    • Example: I’m not going into the sea, the water’s too cold.
       

Correct Answer: Cold.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Lush: (used for plants or gardens) growing very thickly and well. [(पौधे या बग़ीचे) घने और हरे-भरे]
    • Equatorial: near the imagined line around the center of the earth (the equator). [भूमध्य रेखा के निकट का]
    • Sultry: (used about the weather) hot and uncomfortable. [(मौसम) उमस भरा (गरम और कष्‍टप्रद)]

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Distinctive
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Distinctive
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Common'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Distinctive' is 'Common'.
  • Distinctive: clearly different from others and therefore easy to recognize. (सबसे स्‍पष्‍टतया अलग और सरलता से पहचान में आने वाला, भेदकारी)
    • Example: The soldiers were wearing their distinctive red berets.
  • Common: occurring, found, or done often; prevalent. (घटित होना, पाया जाना, या अक्सर किया जाना; प्रचलित।)
    • Example: "salt and pepper are the two most common seasonings"

Correct Answer: common .

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Similarity: the state of being like somebody/something but not exactly the same. [किसी के समान या सदृश (परंतु पूर्णतः वही न) होने की सि्‍थति; समानता, सादृश्‍य]
    • Close: only a short distance away or apart in space or time. (समीप)
    • Original: first; earliest (before any changes or developments). [(किसी परिवर्तन या विकास से पूर्व) प्रथम; आदिम; मूल]

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Frivolous
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Frivolous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Wise'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Frivolous' is 'Wise'.

    • Example: I do not raise that in any frivolous spirit, but it seems to me to be somewhat important.
  • Wise: having the knowledge or experience to make good and sensible decisions and judgements. [बुद्धिमान, समझदार या अक़लमंद व्‍यक्ति (विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने के लिए अपेक्षित ज्ञान या अनुभव से संपन्‍न)]
    • Example: a wise choice...
       

Correct Answer: Wise.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Quiet: with very little or no noise. (शांत, ख़ामोश)
    • Idle: not wanting to work hard; lazy. (मेहनत से जी चुराने वाला, कामचोर; आलसी)
    • Petty: small and unimportant. (छोटा और नगण्य)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Chaste

Chaste
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Corrupt

Key Points

  • Chaste means innocent and pure in thought and act.
    • Example - He remained chaste his whole life.
  • Marked option Corrupt means having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.

  • It is clear that 'Chaste' and 'Corrupt' are opposite in meaning.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Monotonous

Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Monotonous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Varied

Key Points

  • Monotonous means never changing and therefore boring.
    • Example - It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
  • Marked option Varied means having or showing many different types, or changing often.

Additional Information 

  • Elaborate means to add more information or explain something that you have said.
  • Cheerful means feeling or showing happiness.
  • Changing means a state of becoming different.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Petty

Petty

The correct answer is "Big".

  •  Petty :not important and not worth giving attention to.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. RAVISH

Let's look at the meaning of other given options: 

  • Attract: 
    cause (someone) to have a liking for or interest in something.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Beseech
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Beseech
questions.solution: Beseech means 'to ask (someone) urgently and fervently to do something; implore; entreat'. For eg - Stay a little longer, I beseech you! Command means 'to give an authoritative or peremptory order.' Thus, "command" is the antonym of the word "beseech".

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word SERENE

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Fictitious
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fictitious
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Factual'.

Key Points   

  • Fictitious is an adjective that means not real or true; imaginary or fabricated.
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
    • False - not according to truth or fact; incorrect (असत्‍य, ग़लत).
    • Factual - concerned with what is actually the case (तथ्‍यों पर आधारित).
    • Imaginative - having or showing creativity or inventiveness (कल्‍पना से उत्‍पन्‍न, कल्‍पनाशील).
    • Subjective - based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions ((तथ्‍यों के स्‍थान पर) निजी रुचियों और विचारों पर आधारित).
  • From the above meanings, it is evident that factual is the correct antonym for the word fictitious.
  • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Spellbound
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Spellbound
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Disenchanted'.

  • Spellbound is a verb which means to hold the complete attention of (someone) as though by magic; fascinate.

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word. Ruthless
questions.questionHtml:
Select the antonym of the given word.

Ruthless
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- Kind.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

      having or showing no pity or compassion for others. (दूसरों के लिए दया या करुणा न होना या न दिखाना)

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word. Peculiar

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word. URGE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the antonym of the given word.

URGE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Deter.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and the marked option:
    • Urge: to plead, press, or move (someone to do something) 
      • For example: She felt an overwhelming urge to tell someone about what had happened.
    • Deter: discourage (someone) from doing something by instilling doubt or fear of the consequences.
      • For example: Some potential buyers will be deterred by the price.
  • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
    • Persuade: cause (someone) to do something through reasoning or argument.
      • For example: He persuaded his friend to go back to school.
    • Triumph: a great victory or achievement.
      • For example: They gained a magnificent triumph over the invading army. 
    • Request: an act of asking politely or formally for something.
      • For example: They made a request to begin work immediately. 
  • Therefore, we can say that urge and deter are antonyms.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word:
    • Synonyms: advise, counsel, persuade, advocate, recommend, suggest, support, endorse, back, champion.
    • Antonyms: discourage, prevent, dissuade, hinder.

BOISTEROUS

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. RAMBLING

RAMBLING

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given. SEMBLANCE
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in meaning to the word given.

SEMBLANCE
questions.solution:
The correct solution is option 4 i.e. Difference.

Explanation

  • Let us know the meaning of the words given below:
    • Simile is a figure of speech involving the comparison of one thing with another thing of a different kind, used to make a description more emphatic or vivid.
      • ​Example - He runs as fast as lightning. ​
    • Guise means an external form, appearance, or manner of presentation, typically concealing the true nature of something.
      • ​​Example - He turned up at a fancy dress Easter dance in the guise of a white rabbit.
    • Alikeness means similar to each other.
      • ​​Example - The two, so far apart in years, were united by a strong natural bond of sympathy and alikeness.
    • Difference means a point or way in which people or things are dissimilar.
      • ​Example - The difference is that people try to help each other.
  • The word 'Semblance' means resemblance; similarity. From the given meanings, we get to know that 'Difference' is the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. LENIENT
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

LENIENT
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. Strict.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the following points-
  • Lenient- means (of punishment or person in authority) more merciful or tolerant than expected. ((दंड या अधिकार में व्यक्ति) अपेक्षा से अधिक दयालु या सहनशील)
  • Strict-  (of a rule or discipline) demanding total obedience or observance; rigidly enforced. (एक नियम या अनुशासन का) पूर्ण आज्ञाकारिता या पालन की मांग करना; सख्ती से लागू किया गया)
  • Hence, both options i.e. Lenient and Strict express opposite meanings.

Additional Information

Now, let's look at the following points-

  • Generous- showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (कड़ाई से आवश्यक या अपेक्षा से अधिक, विशेष रूप से धन देने के लिए तत्परता दिखाना)
  • Helpful- giving or ready to give help. (मदद देने के लिए तैयार)
  • Defensive- used or intended to defend or protect. (बचाव या रक्षा के लिए इस्तेमाल या इरादा)

Thus, the correct option is Strict and therefore the answer.

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word. EVIDENT
questions.questionHtml:
Select the antonym of the given word.

EVIDENT
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Obscure'. 

Key Points

  • The antonym of the given word 'Evident' is 'Obscure'.

    • Evident easily seen or understood (आसानी से देखा या समझा गया)

      Conspicuous very noticeable or attracting attention, often in a way that is not wanted (बहुत ध्यान देने योग्य या ध्यान आकर्षित करने वाला, अक्सर इस तरह से जो वांछित नहीं है) He tried not to look conspicuous and moved slowly along the back of the room.
      Noticeable easy to see or recognize (देखने या पहचानने में आसान) There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's cooking.
  • Therefore, by reading the above explanation we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

questions.question: Select the antonym of the given word. PAUCITY
questions.questionHtml:
Select the antonym of the given word.

PAUCITY
questions.solution:
The correct answer is - Surplus.

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given word and the marked option:
    • Paucity - a falling short of an essential or desirable amount or number (एक आवश्यक या वांछनीय राशि या संख्या की कमी)

 ​​​​Additional Information  

  • Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word:
    • Synonyms - crunch, dearth, deficiency, deficit, drought
    • Antonyms - abundance, adequacy, amplitude, opulence, plenitude
  • Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: 
    • Scarcity - the quality or state of being scarce (दुर्लभ होने की अवस्था)
    • Availability - the quality or state of being available (उपलब्ध होने की गुणवत्ता या स्थिति)
    • Shortage - To be short or to have need of something (छोटा होना या किसी चीज की कमी होना)

    Impel to force someone to do something.

  • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
    Word Meaning
    Prompt to make something happen.
    Oblige to force someone to do something, or to make it necessary for someone to do something.
    Inspire to make someone feel that they want to do something and can do it.

 

  • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Impel' and 'Repress' are antonyms.
  • So, the correct answer is option 2.​​
